basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Technical Support III - Development Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Medical Science and Technology at Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has invited online applications for one Project Technical Support - III - Development post on the ICMR-sponsored project "Artificial Intelligence Assisted Ultrasound-guided Surgery of Non-palpable Breast Cancer and Therapy (AASTHA)". The consolidated compensation is up to 28000 per month, depending on qualification and experience, with HRA as applicable. The tenure is 24 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The essential qualification is 12th in Science plus a Diploma (MLT/DM

how_to_apply: The notice invites applications online. The web address of the application portal is not printed in the notice. The last date of application is 3 December 2026.
Submit the application online for the advertised assignment by 3 December 2026.

The application fee is shown as 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST. The notice says any fee is to be deposited through RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking to State Bank of India (00202), P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302.
The account name is IIT SRIC-OM Account, account number 39502115210, IFSC code SBIN0000202, SWIFT code SBININBB339.
Mention the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) in the Application Form.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is Project Technical Support - III - Development (1 post). The essential qualification is printed as: 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/ DMLT / Engineering or equivalent) with Five Years Experience in relevant subject / field, or Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject/ field + two years experience in relevant subject. B.E. /B.Tech in Biomedical/Instrumentation or MSc Medical Physics (with relevant experience) are encouraged to apply.

faq.answer: 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/ DMLT / Engineering or equivalent) with Five Years Experience in relevant subject / field, or Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject/ field + two years experience in relevant subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 50 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.
